replication.target_description: Requested target: Relationship between flexibility (inventory management) and discipline (strategic processes) in the overall sample. Located Table 7 instead regresses CUSTOM (product customization), VOLFLEX (volume flexibility), MIXFLEX (mix flexibility), and TTM (time to market) on unified DISCIPLINE, controls and dedicated-line terms. Neither the requested exact outcome nor its original-study predictor subscale is a reported model; no crosswalk is supplied.
